main.description: A comment on a collaborative document. Comments live in the doc's companion comments space (type 'network.habitat.docs.comments', same owner and space key as the doc itself), which inherits the doc space's readers as readers and its writers as writers via network.habitat.relationship.spaceRelation records — so anyone who can read the doc can read its comments, and anyone who can edit it can comment. Each record is written into the commenter's own repo within that space.

threadId.description: Identifier of the comment thread this comment belongs to. The document's own text carries the same id as a 'comment' mark, which is how a thread is anchored to a range of the doc; replies in a thread share its threadId.

quotedText.description: A snapshot of the document text the thread was anchored to when it was created, so a thread whose mark has since been edited away can still be shown with context. Only meaningful on the first comment of a thread.

resolved.description: Whether the thread this comment belongs to has been resolved. Set on the thread's first comment; replies leave it unset.
